paragraphs: See the entry R' Chanin son of Rabbi.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has Chanan son of Berekhyah of Botzrah, both with abbreviated titles retained as R'. The pointer has Chanin with an abbreviated title followed by full בריה דרבי, son of Rabbi, without the father's name. That full Rabbi remains literal; it is not expanded to Berekhyah or Yehudah HaNasi.
